# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'active_support/parameter_filter'

Sentry.init do |config|
  # Include /api as in-app stacktrace lines.
  #
  # Ignore lib/acfs_rails_cache.rb and config/initializers/acfs.rb.
  # They define generic wrappers that would otherwise be the summary for
  # the "primary" line for many exceptions.
  config.app_dirs_pattern = %r{(api|app|config(?!/initializers/acfs.rb$)|lib(?!/acfs_rails_cache.rb$))}

  # Ignore a few common exceptions that sometimes bubble up to Rails' error
  # handling middleware. These are expected to occur and have dedicated
  # handler logic in our exceptions app.
  # We trigger intentional retries using this class, so no need to report them.
  # Far too many exception when sidekiq workers are just reconnecting
  config.excluded_exceptions += %w[
    Acfs::BadGateway
    Acfs::GatewayTimeout
    Acfs::ServiceUnavailable
    Status::NotFound
    Restify::BadGateway
    Restify::GatewayTimeout
    Restify::ServiceUnavailable
    ApplicationJob::ExpectedRetry
    ApplicationJob::Retry
    Redis::CannotConnectError
    RedisClient::CannotConnectError
  ]

  # Do not send full list of gems with each event
  config.send_modules = false

  filter = ActiveSupport::ParameterFilter.new(Rails.application.config.filter_parameters)
  config.before_send = lambda do |event, _hint|
    # use Rails' parameter filter to sanitize the event
    filter.filter(event.to_hash)
  end

  # The default sampling rate for Sentry transactions. Unless other
  # rules apply below, sample all requests by default.
  # Collect profiles are transactions that are sampled.
  config.traces_sample_rate = ENV.fetch('SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE', '1.0').to_f
  config.profiles_sample_rate = 1.0

  config.traces_sampler = lambda do |ctx|

  end
end

interactions.interaction_1: Provides a trace ID (`current_trace&.uuid`) that can be correlated with Sentry events. [Source: app/controllers/errors_controller.rb, config/initializers/sentry.rb]

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Xikolo::S3
  module Seahorse
    class MnemosyneHandler < ::Seahorse::Client::Handler
      # @param [RequestContext] context
      # @return [Response]
      def call(context)
        trace = ::Mnemosyne::Instrumenter.current_trace

        return @handler.call(context) unless trace

        req = context.http_request
        span = ::Mnemosyne::Span.new 'external.http.seahorse',
          meta: {
            url: req.endpoint.to_s,
            method: req.http_method.downcase.to_sym,
          }

        span.start!

        @handler.call(context).tap do |response|
          res = response.context.http_response
          span.meta[:status] = res.status_code

          trace << span.finish!
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

Telegraf::Agent (via Xikolo::Common::Met.description: Provides an interface within the `Xikolo` module for sending custom application metrics (e.g., counters, gauges) to a local Telegraf agent via UDP.

interactions.interaction_0: Receives metric data from application code (e.g., `Xikolo.metrics.increment('event_name')`).
interactions.interaction_1: Sends metric data as UDP packets to `localhost:8094`, where a Telegraf agent is expected to be listening.

techDebt: The `Telegraf::Agent` is configured to send metrics to `udp://localhost:8094`. This implies a strong coupling where a Telegraf agent must be running on the same host as the application instance. In containerized or distributed environments, this requires careful orchestration (e.g., sidecar containers or daemonsets) to ensure the agent is always available and correctly configured. [Source: gems/xikolo-common/lib/xikolo/common/metrics.rb]

AnnotateSentryErrorsForMnemosyne.description: A Rails middleware in the main `web` application responsible for injecting the current Mnemosyne trace ID into the Sentry context. This links Sentry error events to their corresponding distributed traces in Mnemosyne.

interactions.interaction_0: Interacts with `Mnemosyne::Instrumenter` to retrieve the current trace ID.
interactions.interaction_1: Sets context on `Sentry.get_current_scope` to include the Mnemosyne trace ID.
interactions.interaction_2: Processes HTTP requests within the Rails application stack.

Deriving `status_code` from `request.path_info[1..].to_i` is a common Rails pattern for `exceptions_app` but relies on a specific URL structure (e.g., `/404`) which could be brittle if routing changes. [Source: app/controllers/errors_controller.rb]

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Error handler for custom pretty HTTP 4xx/5xx pages.
# Called per Rails convention via config.exceptions_app.
class ErrorsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

##
  # Log an exception and show its pretty error page.
  #
  def show
    log!

    if STATUS_TEMPLATES.key?(status_code)
      pretty_error_page STATUS_TEMPLATES[status_code]
    else
      fallback
    end
  end

MsgrSentryIntegration.description: A Ruby module prepended to `Msgr::Consumer` classes in several microservices. Its purpose is to wrap the `dispatch` method to capture any unhandled exceptions that occur during RabbitMQ message processing and report them to Sentry, while ensuring the exception is re-raised.

interactions.interaction_1: Reports captured exceptions to Sentry using `Sentry.capture_exception`.
interactions.interaction_2: Re-raises exceptions after capture to maintain original error flow.
interactions.interaction_3: Explicitly avoids capturing `Sentry::Error` to prevent infinite loops.

techDebt: The `rubocop:disable Lint/RescueException` comment indicates a suppressed code quality warning, suggesting a broad `rescue Exception` which should be carefully justified.
Missing in `account` and `quiz` services, indicating a gap in error monitoring for their RabbitMQ consumers.

codeBlocks.code:
module MsgrSentryIntegration
  def dispatch(*)
    Sentry.with_scope do
      super
    rescue Sentry::Error
      raise # Don't capture Sentry errors
    rescue Exception => e # rubocop:disable Lint/RescueException
      Sentry.capture_exception(e)
      raise
    end
  end
end

Msgr::Consumer.prepend MsgrSentryIntegration
